prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1258; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with stiffness, mid and low back pain, and headache on the day of the incident. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and mild guarding with lumbar flexion. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits or reflex changes noted.

Conservative care was provided over a course of sixteen visits. Treatment included manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Pain was managed with over-the-counter analgesics as directed, and ice and heat were applied as needed.

By the final visit the patient reported substantial improvement, with neck and back pain reduced and cervical range of motion approaching baseline. Residual stiffness with prolonged sitting persists intermittently. The patient has been advised to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen. Prognosis is good with continued self-management.
